Use this file with one selected slug from [CATALOG.md](../CATALOG.md).

## Brand

This style moves beyond flat design with isometric views, vanishing points, and
layered elements. These techniques guide user attention and create a sense of
realism or "spatial" depth.

## Style foundations

- Visual style: modern, clean, high-contrast
- Typography scale: 12/14/16/20/24/32 | Fonts: primary=Poppins, display=Oswald,
  mono=JetBrains Mono | weights=100, 200, 300, 400, 500, 600, 700, 800, 900
- Color palette: primary, neutral, success, warning, danger | Tokens:
  primary=#00BD7D, secondary=#00BD7D, success=#16A34A, warning=#D97706,
  danger=#DC2626, surface=#FFFFFF, text=#111827
- Spacing scale: 4/8/12/16/24/32

## Copy tone

- Tone: concise, confident, helpful.

## Design intent

Spatial depth design with isometric views, vanishing points, and layered
elements that guide attention through three-dimensional realism.
